Boost to Urban Public Transport connectivity in Kanpur

lines.notes: Kanpur Metro Orange Line (Line 1) operational section spans 14.65 km with 14 stations (9 elevated, 5 underground) from IIT Kanpur to Kanpur Central. Balance section from Kanpur Central to Naubasta (8.65 km, 5 stations) is under active construction. Corridor 2 (Agriculture University to Barra-8, 8.6 km, 8 stations) approved per PIB PRID=1566737 is tracked as an under-construction coverage gap.
